name: Three Kisses in Upper Planetary Orbit
source:
After escaping from an oppressive empire via stolen spaceship, Tiramisu has settled into a comfortable life as the group's sole pilot. But when a rules obsessed supervisor, Flan, asks for her help with organizing a ship wide event, Tira must pull out all the stops to ensure her high-strung superior doesn't go unteased.

As the two try to organize everyone on the ship, you decide how Tira will treat Flan: as a partner to be worked with, a princess to be attended to, or as a pet to be looked after.

[From [url=https://broccolily.itch.io/three-kisses-in-upper-planetary-orbit]itch.io[/url]]
